name: Seino Kasumi
source:
"What's your purpose for coming here?"

A tall, high-achieving girl.
The student council president at the school [url=/c121412]Yuuji[/url] attends. She has some eccentricities, such as referring to herself as "boku" (a masculine pronoun).
While happy to be invited to the test of courage by [url=/c121413]Akane[/url], she also resents Yuji, seeing him as an unnecessary presence.

[Translated from the [url=https://blackutopia777.wixsite.com/blackutopia/blank-c12cw]official website[/url]]
